title: The narrowing pipe
hook: Change pipe cross-sectional area and predict fluid speed.
misconception: fluid speed doubles when pipe cross-sectional area doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply Av = Q to compare fluid speed when pipe cross-sectional area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With steady incompressible flow with fixed volume-flow rate, Av = Q. When pipe cross-sectional area doubles, fluid speed becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Av = Q; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider steady incompressible flow with fixed volume-flow rate, with a nonzero initial result. If pipe cross-sectional area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on fluid speed?
recall.why: Apply Av = Q under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
